lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Season of ForgivenessNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26THE SEASON OF FORGIVENESS: A LETTER FROM BRIXTONThe carbuncle goes back to the Countess, and the plumber goes home, and a Mrs Oakshott of the Brixton Road receives, a week after Christmas, a note and a pound, and a request for the name of the best goose-farmer in Surrey. She frames the note. It is the only thing she has ever received from a celebrity. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
